Custom role with report_manage grants access to report endpoints that a plain agent is denied (KB-074). Setup provisions a report_manage custom role and assigns it to the custom_report_manage user; a plain agent receives 401 on these endpoints, so requiring 200 is a genuine permission discriminator.

inputs.sql: INSERT INTO custom_roles (name, description, account_id, permissions, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'EvalReportManageRole', 'report_manage grant', au.account_id, '{report_manage}', NOW(), NOW() FROM account_users au JOIN users u ON au.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = 'custom_report@eval.test' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custom_roles cr WHERE cr.name = 'EvalReportManageRole' AND cr.account_id = au.account_id); UPDATE account_users SET custom_role_id = (SELECT cr.id FROM custom_roles cr WHERE cr.name = 'EvalReportManageRole' AND cr.account_id = account_users.account_id LIMIT 1) WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'custom_report@eval.test');

nodes.description: conversation_manage permission does NOT grant delete (destroy? is administrator-only in ConversationPolicy) - KB-059. Setup grants the custom_conv_manage user a conversation_manage custom role and inbox access so they can genuinely manage the conversation (GET returns 200); the subsequent DELETE is still denied, proving delete is admin-only rather than covered by conversation_manage.

inputs.sql: INSERT INTO custom_roles (name, description, account_id, permissions, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'EvalConvManageRole', 'conversation_manage grant', au.account_id, '{conversation_manage}', NOW(), NOW() FROM account_users au JOIN users u ON au.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = 'custom_conv@eval.test' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM custom_roles cr WHERE cr.name = 'EvalConvManageRole' AND cr.account_id = au.account_id); UPDATE account_users SET custom_role_id = (SELECT cr.id FROM custom_roles cr WHERE cr.name = 'EvalConvManageRole' AND cr.account_id = account_users.account_id LIMIT 1) WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'custom_conv@eval.test'); INSERT INTO inbox_members (inbox_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT DISTINCT c.inbox_id, (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'custom_conv@eval.test'), NOW(), NOW() FROM conversations c WHERE (c.display_id = {{conversation_id}} OR c.id = {{conversation_id}}) AND c.account_id = (SELECT au.account_id FROM account_users au JOIN users u ON au.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = 'custom_conv@eval.test' LIMIT 1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
